text:
On this provisional model, **keeping the current search allocation leads the comparison**; shifting 30% to LinkedIn does not currently support the stated case.

- The result is driven chiefly by **blended cost per lead**, with LinkedIn qualified-lead volume and retained search leads also material. All underlying estimates are Olumi-authored, not your data.
- It does **not establish** that any route achieves 25% qualified-lead growth or stays below **£80 per lead**: the goal direction is unstated and the model could not convert the 25% threshold into the analysis frame.
- The apparent separation held under tested changes, but cannot be treated as robust validation while every material input remains machine-authored.
